blueprint.name: AWS EKS Existing Cluster + HP Nodes
blueprint.description: Adopt an existing AWS EKS cluster, add a dedicated high-performance node pool with the 3-interface TMM model (CNI + ens7 external + ens8 internal), and lay down the BNK control plane on top. The HP node pool provisions per-AZ TMM-external + TMM-internal subnets and dual secondary ENIs per node; TMM pods land here via app=f5-tmm label. NetworkAttachmentDefinitions (ens7-ipvlan-l2 + ens8-ipvlan-l2) are a manual prerequisite until a dedicated NAD module ships.

estimated_time: 25-40 minutes (existing cluster + HP node pool + BNK install)
estimated_cost: AWS usage-based — adds ~3× m5n.large nodes for the HP pool on top of the existing cluster
outcomes: An existing AWS EKS cluster is referenced by name and adopted into BNK Forge
Per-AZ TMM-external subnets (tagged f5-bnk-role=tmm-external) and TMM-internal subnets (tagged f5-bnk-role=tmm-internal) are created in the cluster VPC
A dedicated HP EKS managed node group is provisioned with app=f5-tmm label, IMDSv2-required launch template, EBS-encrypted root, m5n.large by default (SR-IOV + 100Gbps ENA)
Each HP node attaches two secondary ENIs at first boot: ens7 in TMM-external, ens8 in TMM-internal — both tagged node.k8s.amazonaws.com/no_manage=true
BNK namespaces, FAR pull secrets, and component manifest are deployed
Jetstack cert-manager is installed with BNK-compatible defaults
The BNK CA-backed ClusterIssuer is created and ready for FLO + OTEL certs
F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) is installed with AWS-tuned defaults; BNK CRDs are registered
CNEInstance is applied with AWS-specific cneController env vars + network_attachments=[ens7-ipvlan-l2, ens8-ipvlan-l2]; FLO schedules TMM pods onto HP nodes
AWS IRSA is wired for the CNE controller — IAM role + OIDC trust + SA annotation
BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) listener networks are auto-built from the HP-nodes TMM-external subnets via cneinstall's apply-time rediscovery

prerequisites.description: An existing AWS EKS cluster reachable from the project. Use the 'AWS EKS Cluster Create' blueprint to provision one if you don't have it yet.

prerequisites.name: aws_credentials
prerequisites.description: AWS credential template using any of Forge's three auth methods: access_keys (static IAM keys), profile (named AWS profile on the Forge runner), or sso (AWS SSO / Identity Center). All three resolve to the same access_key_id + secret_access_key + session_token at deploy time.

prerequisites.name: cne_pull_secret
prerequisites.description: Base64-encoded F5 FAR registry credentials (bare service-account JSON key OR dockerconfigjson). Bound from a stored project secret in the deploy form.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Provide AWS credentials, region, the existing EKS cluster name, and the F5 FAR pull secret. HP-node defaults (m5n.large × 1 per AZ, /24 TMM subnets carved from VPC at offset 200/210) work for most deployments; override if your VPC is tight on CIDR space or you need higher TMM throughput.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Auto-resolved from the AWS credential template regardless of auth method (access_keys / profile / sso).

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Auto-resolved from the AWS credential template regardless of auth method.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region where the existing EKS cluster resides.

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the existing AWS EKS cluster to adopt.

required.name: cne_pull_secret
required.description: F5 FAR registry credentials. Bind to a stored project secret in the deploy form.

required.name: jwt_token
required.description: F5 BNK License JWT. Bind to a stored project secret in the deploy form.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS, SSO, and assumed-role-derived profiles; empty for long-lived IAM user keys.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for FLO and all BNK components.

optional.name: bnk_manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version to download from FAR.

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: FLO license mode: 'connected' (talks to F5 license server) or 'f5licenseproxy' (talks to a local F5 License Proxy).

optional.name: container_platform
optional.description: FLO containerPlatform value. AWS-tuned default; override only if you need to test against a different platform path in the FLO chart.

optional.name: deployment_size
optional.description: CNEInstance deploymentSize per F5 docs: Small / Medium / Large / Max (2/4/8/16 CPU, 4/8/16/25 GiB hugepages-2Mi).

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.description: Number of TMM replicas. 0 = auto-derive from cluster topology: min(AZ count, worker node count). Set a positive number to override. Cluster admin still has to label nodes with app=f5-tmm for FLO to schedule TMM pods.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.description: Which namespaces the CNE controller watches for Gateway/HTTPRoute CRs. ['All'] watches everything.

optional.name: network_attachments
optional.description: NetworkAttachmentDefinition names attached to TMM. Default matches the dual-ENI HP node pool: ens7-ipvlan-l2 (external) and ens8-ipvlan-l2 (internal). Both NADs must exist on the cluster — see prerequisites.

optional.name: vip_cidr
optional.description: CIDR for BNK Gateway VIP allocation. Module derives the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) start/end addresses from this. Empty = let cneinstall auto-discover from the HP-nodes TMM-external subnets (typical for this blueprint). Set explicitly only if VIPs live outside the TMM-external CIDR range.

optional.name: hp_instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for HP nodes. Must support at least 3 ENIs (primary + 2 secondary). Default m5n.large is the minimum; consider m5n.xlarge / c5n.xlarge for higher TMM throughput.

optional.name: hp_node_count_per_az
optional.description: Desired HP nodes per AZ. Total HP nodes = this × availability_zone_count. Default 1 per AZ gives 1-TMM-per-AZ when tmm_replicas auto-derives.

modules.name: EKS Cluster Register
modules.description: Reference an existing EKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs.

modules.name: HP TMM Node Pool
modules.description: Provision dedicated TMM-external + TMM-internal subnets per AZ, an HP EKS managed node group (m5n.large), and dual secondary ENIs (ens7 external + ens8 internal) on each node. cneinstall later rediscovers the tagged subnets to wire the BNKGateway CR's listener networks.

modules.name: TMM NADs (Multus + ens7/ens8 NetworkAttachmentDefinitions)
modules.description: Install Multus CNI and the ens7-ipvlan-l2 + ens8-ipvlan-l2 NetworkAttachmentDefinitions TMM needs for its dual data-plane interfaces. Each NAD's static-address placeholder is derived from the matching f5-bnk-role-tagged subnet via apply-time discovery — no hardcoded 10.10.1.1/24.

modules.name: BNK Prerequisites
modules.description: Create BNK namespaces, FAR image pull secrets, and download the BNK manifest.

modules.name: Cert-Manager
modules.description: Install Jetstack cert-manager with BNK-compatible defaults.

modules.name: BNK Cert Issuer
modules.description: Create the BNK-managed self-signed CA and ClusterIssuer used by FLO + OTEL certs.

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Install FLO via Helm with AWS-tuned defaults (containerPlatform=AWS, fluentbit sidecar disabled, IPAM operator in default ns). Registers BNK CRDs.

modules.name: CNEInstance + IRSA
modules.description: Apply the CNEInstance CR with AWS production defaults, the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap, the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) for VIP IPAM (when vip_cidr is set), and wire AWS IRSA for the CNE controller (IAM role + SA annotation + rollout-restart).
